package tcp

import (
	"MMO_MODULE/db"
	cell "MMO_MODULE/game/entities/cell_player"
	player "MMO_MODULE/game/entities/player"
	"MMO_MODULE/game/modules/cellworldhost"
	apperrors "MMO_MODULE/internal/errors"
	"MMO_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"MMO_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/entitysync"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/frame"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/errcode"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// Decode from a fresh baseline on every new TCP connection, including pushes interleaved with RPC responses.
type cellProbe struct {
	transport.Conn
	decoder *entitysync.Decoder
	fields  *db.PlayerDao
	subject int64
	created bool
}

func (c *cellProbe) ReadPacket() (*transport.Packet, error) {
	p, e := c.Conn.ReadPacket()
	if e != nil || p.MsgID != msgid.MsgSelfSync {
		return p, e
	}
	f, e := c.decoder.Decode(p.Payload)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	for _, o := range f.Objects {
		for _, part := range o.Components {
			u := part.Update
			if u.Namespace != "player" || len(u.Payload.BytesCopy()) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			if c.subject != 0 && c.subject != u.SubjectID {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("self view changed identity")
			}
			c.subject = u.SubjectID
			c.created = c.created || o.Operation == frame.ObjectCreate
			if e = c.fields.ApplySync(u.Payload.BytesCopy()); e != nil {
				return nil, e
			}
		}
	}
	return p, nil
}
func dialCellProbe(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context) (*cellProbe, *pb.EnterStatusPush) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := transport.DialPlayerTCP(ctx, transport.Config{Endpoint: os.Getenv("CELL_ADDR"), DialTimeout: time.Second})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stop := context.AfterFunc(ctx, func() { _ = raw.Close() })
	t.Cleanup(func() { stop(); _ = raw.Close() })
	c := &cellProbe{Conn: raw, decoder: entitysync.NewDecoder(frame.DefaultLimits()), fields: db.NewPlayerDao()}
	auth := transport.AuthPacket(os.Getenv("CELL_TICKET"))
	auth.Seq = 1
	if err = c.WritePackets([]*transport.Packet{auth}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ack, err := c.ReadPacket()
	if err != nil || ack.MsgID != 0 || len(ack.Payload) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("auth: %+v %v", ack, err)
	}
	p, err := c.ReadPacket()
	for err == nil && p.MsgID == msgid.MsgSelfSync {
		p, err = c.ReadPacket()
	}
	if err != nil || p.MsgID != msgid.MsgEnterStatus {
		t.Fatalf("status: %+v %v", p, err)
	}
	s, err := pb.UnmarshalEnterStatusPush(p.Payload)
	if err != nil || s.Code != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("status %+v %v", s, err)
	}
	return c, s
}

func (c *cellProbe) await(t *testing.T, ready func() bool) {
	t.Helper()
	for !ready() {
		if _, err := c.ReadPacket(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("self snapshot x=%d y=%d hp=%d: %v", c.fields.GetPosX(), c.fields.GetPosY(), c.fields.GetCellHP(), err)
		}
	}
}

func (c *cellProbe) move(t *testing.T, vx, vy int64, want error) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := pb.MarshalCellMoveRequest(&pb.CellMoveRequest{VX: vx, VY: vy})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r, err := pb.UnmarshalCellMoveResponse(recipeRequest(t, c, msgid.MsgCellMove, raw))
	wantCode, wantReason := errcode.ClientError(want)
	if err != nil || r.Code != wantCode || r.Reason != wantReason {
		t.Fatalf("CellMove(%d,%d): %+v %v; want %d %q", vx, vy, r, err, wantCode, wantReason)
	}
	if want != nil {
		t.Logf("CellMove(%d,%d) rejected: code=%d reason=%q", vx, vy, r.Code, r.Reason)
	}
}

func TestPartitionLiveClient(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 22*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	c, s := dialCellProbe(t, ctx)
	mode := os.Getenv("CELL_ACTION")
	if s.NeedCreate != (mode == "ordinary") {
		t.Fatalf("need create=%v mode=%s", s.NeedCreate, mode)
	}
	if s.NeedCreate {
		if r := recipeCreate(t, c, "walker"); r.Code != 0 {
			t.Fatal(r)
		}
	}
	if mode == "right" {
		c.move(t, 1, 0, apperrors.ErrCellspaceNotEntered)
	}
	recipeEnter(t, c)
	if mode == "ordinary" {
		c.move(t, 1, 0, apperrors.ErrCellspaceDisabled)
		return
	}
	// The first usable state comes from the new connection, not a previous decoder or Redis.
	c.await(t, func() bool {
		return c.created && c.fields.GetCellHP() != 0 && ((mode != "recover" && mode != "left") || c.fields.GetPosX() >= 1000)
	})
	player.RegisterEntity()
	cell.RegisterEntity()
	ids := cellworldhost.PlayerIDs{BaseKind: player.EntityKindPlayer}
	unique := entity.GetUniqueIDFromEntityID(c.subject)
	a, err := ids.Actor(c.subject)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("identity %d %d %d\n", unique, c.subject, a)
	x := c.fields.GetPosX()
	if mode == "recover" || mode == "left" {
		if x < 1000 {
			t.Fatalf("new connection did not restore right cell x=%d", x)
		}
	}
	if mode == "recover" {
		return
	}
	v := int64(800)
	if mode == "left" {
		v = -800
	}
	c.move(t, v, 0, nil)
	c.await(t, func() bool { return v > 0 && c.fields.GetPosX() >= 1200 || v < 0 && c.fields.GetPosX() <= 800 })
	c.move(t, 0, 0, nil)
	// Keep this independent restart test online until the periodic durable writeback.
	if mode == "right" {
		time.Sleep(6 * time.Second)
	}
	t.Log("new client saw X", strconv.FormatInt(x, 10), "then", c.fields.GetPosX())
}
